steps.quote: An employee fills in the claim form and attaches the receipts
The employee then submits the claim to their line manager
The line manager checks the claim against the travel policy
the manager sends the claim back to the employee with a note
the employee corrects the claim and submits it again
Finance checks whether the claim is over 500 pounds
The finance director reviews large claims within five working days
Claims over 500 pounds need sign-off from the finance director

steps.text: Schedule payment for next pay run
steps.quote: finance schedules the payment for the next pay run
the system emails a confirmation to the employee

flows.label: Yes
flows.quote: If the claim is within policy, the line manager approves it

flows.label: No
flows.quote: If it is not, the manager sends the claim back to the employee with a note
the employee corrects the claim and submits it again
Approved claims go to the finance team

flows.label: Over 500

flows.label: Yes
flows.quote: Once a claim is cleared, finance schedules the payment for the next pay run
